newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Andersen Consulting joints Smart car project.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Consulting joints Smart car project.

text.p: Micro Compact Car AG (MCC), a joint venture to produce the new "Smart" model car, said it had signed a long-term contract with Andersen Consulting to join the project.
Daimler-Benz unit Mercedes-Benz AG and Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horologerie own MCC.
"In the first phase MCC and Andersen Consulting will develop and implement by June 1998 the business and production processes for the vehicle," it said in a statement.
Andersen will be in charge of introducing the small new city car to the market in early 1998.
MCC will outsource the programme management and information technology operations to Andersen, it said. MCC remains responsible for the car's development, production and sales.
